source.population: SK1 EXPLORATION (development data; the frozen model was fit on it)

readings.IN_SAMPLE: frozen rule exactly as shipped, applied to the classes the model was fit on: resubstitution, optimistic
readings.OUT_OF_BAG: for each class, only the bags whose family bootstrap never drew the class's origin family (at least 2 risk bags and 1 regret bag); a diagnostic estimator, NOT the frozen rule
readings.OUT_OF_FOLD_REFERENCE: aggregate recorded by the trainer before validation, in SK1_TRAINING_RECORD.json; cited, not recomputed (recomputing would require training)

disclosure: Opaque aliases only. No seed, world hash, coordinate, utility or member identity. Per-action flags are categorical outcomes of the frozen evaluator on the sampled member worlds; "NONE" does not mean universally safe.

crossClassFeatureCollisions.note: identical 144-feature rows that occur in more than one class
